periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 45 degrees downward and inward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid; elongated along the primary diagonal axis with a width-to-height ratio roughly 1:1.4.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lower terminal point extending significantly further from the geometric center than the upper margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile along the posterior margin across the upper shoulder region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderate; the band covers approximately one-third of the visible distance from the base of the neck to the lower abdominal line.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation, roughly equivalent to twice the individual width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and highly rounded at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tinted fur discoloration localized on the ventral abdominal region and inner hind limbs.
